anchor_rule: minimum preflight eth_blockNumber across the selected endpoints
note: The anchor height makes block-parameter requests repeatable: a rerun at the same height sends the same eth_feeHistory and eth_getLogs bodies. It does not promise the same response shape after a protocol or client change. A reproduction mismatch is a difference pending review, not an invalidation of this sample. web3_clientVersion is context only and is not a client attribution.
